sales.palletEstimateLater: Pallet count is available only after a saved shipment is calculated with a verified pallet type.

sales.shipmentHint: Create a shipment from the remaining saved quantities. No pallet or container is chosen by Sales.

catalog.title: Products & cartons
catalog.description: Products identify the goods; packaging units define the verified rectangular cartons used by the planner. A drawing is illustrative, not measured evidence.
catalog.empty: No products yet. Create the first product on the right.
catalog.name: Name
catalog.rectangularOnly: The current planner supports rectangular cartons only.
catalog.selectPackaging: Choose a packaging unit in the catalog to inspect and verify it.
catalog.topFaceFixed: The original top face must stay up. A 90° turn on the pallet deck can be allowed; laying on a side is not supported.
catalog.saveError: Could not save. Check the fields or current revision.

palletTypes.title: Pallet types
palletTypes.description: Define available pallet types with evidenced solid-deck support. Sales does not edit these limits; planning uses them as hard constraints.
palletTypes.solidDeckNote: Only a verified solid support deck is supported. Ordinary slatted pallets need a separate support model.
palletTypes.saveError: Could not save pallet type. Check the evidence and limits.

warehouse.title: Placement preview
warehouse.description: Review the saved model layout carton by carton in 2D or 3D. This is a preview, not an executable warehouse task.
warehouse.notReleasedDetail: Approval, transport checks and warehouse task confirmation are not implemented. Do not use this calculation as a loading instruction.
warehouse.unplacedDetail: No placement step exists for these cartons.
warehouse.empty: Choose a shipment and saved plan to inspect its positions.

productList.createHint: Start with a product identity. Add measured carton dimensions on its detail page.
productList.choosePackaging: Choose a carton type to inspect its shape and handling rules.
productList.demoShape: The current engine handles rectangular cartons only; product shapes and side-laying need separate verified models.
productList.orbitHint: Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom

scene.orbitHint: Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom

palletReference.title: Pallet dimension references
palletReference.caution: These published EPAL dimensions are reference information only, not selectable packing types. Slatted decks are not modeled by the current solid-deck engine; site-specific condition, support, capacity and loaded-height limits must be verified first.

demo.warning: Demo pallet dimensions, weight limits and carton evidence are fictional. Use this calculation only to test the interface and model; never as a loading instruction.

status.title: Workspace status
status.description: Catalog, orders and conservative pallet planning are connected to the API. Plans are model-checked, not approved for warehouse release or transport safety.
status.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
status.unavailable: Warehouse release and transport checks are not available yet.

auth.title: Sign in to Pallet Building
auth.invalid: The email or password is incorrect.
auth.required: Enter a valid email and password.

workspace.title: Catalog and orders
workspace.description: Create products, packaging, orders and shipments. Dimensions are in millimetres; mass is entered in kilograms.
workspace.saveError: Could not save. Check for a conflict or invalid data.

planning.description: This planner supports verified, complete cartons in aligned columns on a solid-deck pallet.
